🔥 The fire settles. Weiguo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ella says quietly "We've been walking past those." Nicole asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
